name: Elbe ferry Glückstadt–Wischhafen (FRS Elbfähre), trucks and their load
law: FRS Elbfähre's fares for trucks and cargo, valid 1 January to 31 December 2025 (the Internet Archive's copy of 10 November 2025): a truck, unloaded and without its driver, net of 19% VAT, by its length over all: to 5 m EUR 13.03, to 6 m EUR 15.55, to 7 m EUR 18.91, to 8 m EUR 22.27, to 9 m EUR 23.53, to 10 m EUR 24.37, to 11 m EUR 26.47, to 12 m EUR 27.73, to 13 m EUR 28.99, to 14 m EUR 30.67, to 15 m EUR 32.35, to 16 m EUR 33.19, to 17 m EUR 34.45, to 18.35 m EUR 35.71, each further metre (overhanging ones too) EUR 4.20, at most 23 m; the load by weight, EUR 1.18 per started 1,000 kg. The driver's own fare (adults "from" EUR 3.40) isn't added, nor the surcharges for over 2.50 m wide (30%) or dangerous goods, nor the frequent travellers' discounts. Ports at OpenStreetMap's ferry terminals, priced where the line goes out on its car ferry line.
